title: APPROVAL OF PURCHASE ORDER CHANGE NO. 1 TO AGREEMENT NO. 471 WITH FERGUSON US HOLDINGS INC. DBA FERGUSON ENTERPRISES LLC DBA FERGUSON WATERWORKS
text:
RESOLUTION NO. ____________ - APPROVAL OF PURCHASE ORDER CHANGE NO. 1 TO AGREEMENT NO. 471 WITH FERGUSON US HOLDINGS INC. DBA FERGUSON ENTERPRISES LLC DBA FERGUSON WATERWORKS
Transmittal 1
Transmittal 2
Summary
: Staff requests approval of Purchase Order Change No. 1 to Agreement No. 471 (Contract) with Ferguson US Holdings Inc. dba Ferguson Enterprises LLC dba Ferguson Waterworks (Ferguson), headquartered in Virginia with a location in Pomona, California, for plumbing supplies, equipment, appliances, fittings, fixtures, trim and accessories. The Contract went into effect on January 30, 2024, for a one-year term, with two one-year renewal options for the maximum expenditure authority of $200,000 annually, or $600,000 if all renewal options are exercised. If the proposed change is approved, the maximum expenditure authority for the second renewal contract period will increase by $100,000, from $200,000 currently to $300,000, as proposed. This will increase the total current three-year contract authority of $600,000 to $700,000. The requested increase is necessary to complete current and planned capital and maintenance projects due to unforeseen repairs that occurred in the second renewal period. The proposed action is aligned with the City of Los Angeles (City) Harbor Department’s (Harbor Department) Strategic Plan, Objective 1: World Class Infrastructure that Promotes Growth and Objective 2: An Efficient, Secure, and Sustainable Supply Chain. The Harbor Department will continue to be financially responsible for the payment of expenses incurred under the Contract.
Recommendation
: Board resolve to 1) find that the Director of Environmental Management has determined that the proposed action is administratively exempt from the requirements of the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) under Article II, Section 2(f) of the Los Angeles City CEQA Guidelines; 2) approve Purchase Order Change No. 1 to Agreement No. 471 with Ferguson to increase the annual expenditure authority from $200,000 to $300,000 for the current contract period, which is in its second renewal option year; 3) authorize the Executive Director to execute and the Board Secretary to attest to Purchase Order Change No. 1 for and on behalf of the Board; and 4) adopt Resolution No.__________.
